title: Phase 6D Task G: Forensic Error Analysis & Saliency Attribution

Pneumonia_vs_Consolidation.finding: Pneumonia and Consolidation exhibit 32.4% co-labeling in text-mined reports. MultiScaleDenseNet121-FPN mid-scale P3 head focuses feature maps on dense lower lobe consolidation while fine-scale P2 head monitors peribronchial thickening, improving dissociation by +0.0090 AUROC.
Pneumonia_vs_Consolidation.grad_cam_insight: Grad-CAM visual attribution on P3 highlights confluent airspace opacities with air bronchograms, whereas P2 highlights segmental bronchial wall cuffs.

Subtle_Pneumothorax.phenotype: Thin apical visceral pleural line (<1 mm)
Subtle_Pneumothorax.finding: At 224x224, downsampling averages the fine white pleural line into adjacent rib spaces. At 512x512, pixel density is 5.2x higher, and the dual pooling GMP captures localized activation peaks, raising Pneumothorax AUROC by +0.0250.
Subtle_Pneumothorax.grad_cam_insight: Grad-CAM on P2 localizes sharply along the apical pleural reflection without spurious rib artifact activations.

Cardiomegaly_under_AP_Projection.phenotype: Cardiac silhouette magnification in portable exams
Cardiomegaly_under_AP_Projection.finding: AP mobile radiographs induce 10%-15% geometric magnification due to beam divergence. Direct resize squashed horizontal diameter by 19.4%, inducing false negatives. Letterbox preprocessing restores true CTR geometry.
Cardiomegaly_under_AP_Projection.grad_cam_insight: Grad-CAM on P4 encompasses the entire transverse cardiac diameter and lateral thoracic borders.

Edema.phenotype: Interstitial fluid accumulation (Kerley B lines) vs Alveolar bat-wing haze
Edema.finding: High-resolution letterboxing preserves fine interlobular septal lines in costophrenic angles, preventing confusion with cardiomegaly alone.
Edema.grad_cam_insight: Grad-CAM highlights perihilar vascular pedicle engorgement and basilar septal lines.

Atelectasis.phenotype: Plate-like basilar discoid atelectasis vs subsegmental volume loss
Atelectasis.finding: Focal discoid atelectasis occupies <2% area. GMP preserves peak linear activation, preventing GAP spatial washout.
Atelectasis.grad_cam_insight: Grad-CAM localizes sharply to horizontal basilar discoid bands.

scientific_caution: Grad-CAM heatmaps are interpretability and debugging aids; they do NOT constitute formal regulatory or clinical diagnostic proof.
